name: kition
description: Kition — documents, structured tables, AI agents, and visual workflows

scripts.check:deps: depcruise --config tooling/dependency-cruiser.cjs --ignore-known tooling/dependency-cruiser.known.json --output-type err src packages
scripts.check:deps:update: depcruise --config tooling/dependency-cruiser.cjs --baseline tooling/dependency-cruiser.known.json --baseline-mode shrink-only src packages
scripts.check: pnpm run check:branding && pnpm run check:product-language && pnpm run check:i18n && pnpm run check:blank-comments && pnpm run check:knip && pnpm run check:deps && pnpm run check:tessera && pnpm run check:e2e-coverage && pnpm run check:contracts && pnpm run check:kit-host && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:security && pnpm run build:check && pnpm test
scripts.build:check: pnpm run check:desktop-assets && pnpm run check:notices && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build
scripts.check:desktop: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.test:agent:stable: pnpm run test:agent:unit && pnpm run test:agent:e2e
scripts.test:desktop:unit: vitest run --config tooling/vitest.config.ts src/services/desktop.spec.ts src/services/desktopBootstrap.spec.ts src/services/portalAccount.spec.ts src/services/desktopClient/tauriBridge.spec.ts src-tauri/scripts
scripts.test:desktop:e2e: playwright test --config tooling/playwright.config.ts e2e/desktop-bundled-assets.spec.ts e2e/desktop-design-studio.spec.ts e2e/desktop-design.spec.ts e2e/desktop-image-copy.spec.ts e2e/desktop-image-import.spec.ts e2e/desktop-image-paste.spec.ts e2e/desktop-selection-translation.spec.ts e2e/desktop-shortcuts.spec.ts e2e/settings-desktop.spec.ts e2e/settings-desktop-network.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:ci: KITION_E2E_SCOPE=ci playwright test --config tooling/playwright.config.ts --workers=2 && playwright test --config tooling/playwright.config.ts e2e/design-performance.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:design:e2e: playwright test --config tooling/playwright.config.ts e2e/design-editor.spec.ts e2e/desktop-design.spec.ts e2e/design-performance.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.capture:readme:assets: KITION_CAPTURE_README_ASSETS=1 playwright test --config tooling/playwright.config.ts e2e/readme-assets.spec.ts --workers=1 && magick docs/readme/documents.png -quality 88 -define webp:method=6 docs/readme/documents.webp && magick docs/readme/agent.png -quality 88 -define webp:method=6 docs/readme/agent.webp && magick docs/readme/boards.png -quality 88 -define webp:method=6 docs/readme/boards.webp && magick docs/readme/kition-overview.png -quality 88 -define webp:method=6 docs/readme/kition-overview.webp && magick docs/readme/design-studio.png -quality 88 -define webp:method=6 docs/readme/design-studio.webp && rm docs/readme/documents.png docs/readme/agent.png docs/readme/boards.png docs/readme/design-studio.png
scripts.test:collab:e2e: playwright test --config tooling/playwright.config.ts e2e/collab-photo.spec.ts e2e/collab-film.spec.ts e2e/collab-slide.spec.ts e2e/collab-doc.spec.ts e2e/collab-sheet.spec.ts e2e/collab-vector.spec.ts e2e/collab-effect.spec.ts e2e/collab-cad.spec.ts e2e/collab-pdf.spec.ts e2e/collab-note.spec.ts --workers=1
